17. a) Walter F. Szczepanski 
b) 1551 West Klein Avenue
c) Private Citizen
d) 62 & 150
e) Opposed to the Airport Spur because we already have good access to the airport using Highway 100, Rawson Avenue and College Avenue via Howell Avenue.
f) Questioned the shifting of the jurisdictional responsibility for Grange Avenue relocation.
Pointed out the fact that field noise measurements were taken when North West Airlines were on strike resulting in 38 less flights per day.
Claimed that permitting longer trucks on the freeway will produce more noise.
g) This comment is irrelevant to the proposed freeway project.
This statement is correct. See page 121 for a response.
Present state statutes limit
the length of all trucks and
current federal regulations
limit the noise levels of new
trucks. In addition, if truck
lengths are increased, the number
required to haul materials would
be reduced.
18. a) Roy Gardetto 
c) Represented Milwaukee County Expressway and Transportation Commission
d) 65
e) Read Statement by Gordon A.
King, Chairman of the Milwaukee
County Expressway and Transportation Commission. Stated the
Commission participated in the
development of the Airport Spur
and that Alternate #5 appears
to offer the least disruptive
connection to the airport with minimal
adverse environmental impacts.
f) ---
g) No response necessary.
